system.description:
Range 60ft; 20ft-radius sphere fixed on a point or object, for 1 round per level. Nonmagical light is extinguished and magical light of spell level 2 or lower is suppressed; no creature can see inside, darkvision included. Cast reversed (Light), it sheds bright light in 20ft radius for the same duration and dispels Darkness of equal or lower level.

Reversible: may be cast as its opposite with the same slot.

Classes: Cleric, Wizard, Illusionist, Bard, Sorcerer, Magus
